payload.reason: The evidence indicates that RR-based fingerprint construction significantly enhances the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in detecting forced climate signals, particularly in precipitation data. Without this method, the ability to distinguish forced signals from internal variability would be compromised, leading to lower detection confidence.

claims.text: RR-based fingerprint construction improves the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) for detecting forced responses in precipitation data.
Without RR-based fingerprint construction, the detection of forced signals would be less robust due to increased influence from internal variability.
